description: The Universal Battery Database is the Jeff Dahn Research Group's Python software for managing and modelling lithium-ion cell measurements. It organises cycling and impedance files, cell chemistry and geometry, experimental conditions and quality-control information, with machine-learning and physics-based analysis workflows. Inputs are users' measurement files and metadata; outputs include a searchable database, diagnostic visualisations and fitted or predicted responses. Geographic coverage and observation periods follow the supplied experiments. Public source is free under Apache-2.0. A limitation is that the repository describes modelling results as preliminary and does not publish a universal measured-cell inventory simply by providing the software. Users can install the modelling tools separately or configure the full database. The package can prepare battery-ageing evidence for electric-vehicle and stationary-storage simulations, complementing PyPSA (model-pypsa) for system studies. The README links detailed installation and analysis guidance. No experimental measurements, database snapshot or fitted model was downloaded.
